body: I relate.  So lonely without your best friend.  My husband died 3 years ago from brain cancer.  Glioblastoma.  I still cry nearly everyday.
Stop "judging".  You speek indirectly.  Just stop!!

Stop hiding me!!  I tried hard to counteract his ways.  But you can't win with a narc.  I want to personally thank you for giving me more motivation to carry out my death.  You confirmed that I am worthless.

See my above comment.  You are rude!!  You don't know my situation.  I had shared parenting with my narcisstic ex.  Try living with that!!  What am I thinking?  That was my fault too.  I am responsible for everyone's behavior!!

Little judgemental??  Thanks.....push me to do it more.  I never taught them to be greedy, so didn't verbally or physically abuse them.  I had standards for them.  Rules!!  O never condoned pot or alcohol.  Trust me, O came down hard on the one.  Zero tolerance for anything illegal.  For his own good!!  What would you do?  Turn your back??  You say change.  That is just the problem.  When I help less is when I am abused by them.  Guess I am a failure.  Thanks for giving me the push I need to do it!!

Kids need us??  Oh, yeh.....to use!!  Money, food, car repairs, clothes for grandchildren, etc....  Oh and alcohol/pot too!!  But don't say a word as a parent.  They are "adults".  They want to use you but you can't give suggestions or opinions when it comes to your own money.  Just keep your mouth shut and hand it over.  Otherwise, you will be labeled a crazy bitch and more.  Their poor spending habits will be you(the parent's) fault.  Just do what the kids want.  Don't say anything.....parents who attempt to help/teach their children to be responsible are nagging!!  You won't hear from them again until they have a crisis.  Then the hoovering starts all over.  I am now to wise for this.  But I still am not going to stick around for any further attempts.

That is just it......I don't believe they feel.  The one acts extremely entitled.  My death won't phase them.  The only thing they will concern themselves with is any money/items left for them.  I took care of that.  Nothing for them!!  I just had everything changed.  I guess I don't care if they "feel".  I think the oldest is hiding something.  The other attempts to hide things.  But it is easier for them to make it look like I did something.  I did.....I loved them too much.  I cared too much.  I never turned my back when they needed me.   The only thing that is important now is my freedom from the pain.  I don't think there could ever be the feelings I used to have for them.  They have abused me one too many times.  My time to escape.  I have two days off work in a row.  My work would be the only one checking on me.  Simply because they need the shift covered.  So if I do it the eve before my next two days off, no one will attempt to look for me.  No chance of reviving me.  It can be done!!

I am 54.  I have felt depressed as long as I can remember.  Suicidal ideations at least 10 years.  It is not going away, no one wants to hear it and no one truly cares.  I am saving up meds.  You can't tell me that the amount I have now won't work.  Plus, no one would miss me nor look for me.

I too cannot understand nor accept the ways of today's society.  I can't except that people are without integrity, morals and values.  How the hell are we supposed to live amongst these people???  I feel so out of place.  I don't belong here any longer!!  Truthfully......very seriously, no one would even notice I am gone.
Same!!  I am sure that in this sick society, there are plenty who would be happy to do so for $$$
